items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Freddy Kepler, I didn't hear him play until I went to Chicago. I used to hear him talking about him when I went to Chicago and find out I heard him play, but I never did hear him play nothing in New Orleans.

ctx.x: Just asking about your father in Chicago.

Oh yeah, well you see my father, at first he used to be a very good friend to Alphonse Mix. Alphonse Mix used to have the Tannery Club that was at Perdido and Drive. And him and my father were real good friends. Now he used to tell me about all the old musicians like Buddy Boland and Bab Frank and those people. And when I was about, I'd say about six or seven years old, my father brought me out to Lincoln Park. And they used to have a man, used to go up in a balloon. I think his name was Bartley, and Buddy Boland…
